The '''Zhell''' were a historical [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The species was believed to be the origin for the name of [[Zhellday]], a [[Standard day|day]] in the [[standard week]].<ref name="Falcon 61" /> The species shared its name with the [[Taung & Zhell Society]], a student group at the [[University of Coruscant]],<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> and the [[Zhell Reversal]] card game.<ref name="Smuggler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zhell were first mentioned in the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 61|sixty-first issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="Falcon 61" /> published around [[March 2]], [[2016]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|61}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] were first mentioned in the liner notes for the [[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]]<ref name="SotE">[[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]] liner notes</ref> and were believed to be the ancestors of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="TEGW">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>
